# Solution Setup

Use the `calculator-setup` skill as the source of truth for this workflow. The
skill owns the setup procedure, required package versions, bundled script,
starter templates, validation commands, and troubleshooting guidance.

## Required Action

Run the calculator setup skill workflow to create or verify the .NET 8
calculator solution under `src/workspace/calculator-xunit-testing/`.

The Dev Container initially supplies SDK 8. Create `net8.0` projects and
`calculator.sln`; SDK 8 cannot build `.slnx`. Keep this baseline through the
CSV and PostgreSQL prompts. Install SDK 10 and upgrade through GitHub Copilot
upgrade only at prompt `3.01`. Do not downgrade an existing later-stage
workspace by rerunning initial setup.

The workflow must remain limited to solution setup. Do not implement calculator
operations, data-driven tests, CSV migration, PostgreSQL setup, CI/CD, or later
prompt stages while handling this prompt.

## Pre-configure for subsequent refactor steps

Initially, create the arithmetic operations as case statements within the console application to allow demonstrating a refactoring step later to convert them into methods for better testability.

Also initially configure methods to be private within the console application, and later refactor them at prompt 1.12.3... to be public for the test project accessibility.

Also to later demonstrate the refactoring and improvements, initially exclude the modulo and exponent operations from the console application.

## Success Criteria

The workflow is complete when the skill reports that setup succeeded.
